market_summary: Rates are the main weight: the 10-year ended the week near 5.10%, futures price about an 85% chance of a hold on Oct 28 but roughly 89% odds of a December hike, and the Fed is in blackout until the decision. The Nasdaq fell 4.5% for its worst week since June and the Philadelphia semiconductor index has dropped eight sessions straight, its longest run since October 2008, as investors question debt-funded AI capex (CoreWeave -25% on the week, CDS near 1,117bp). Brent closed Friday at $109.86, its highest since May, and on Saturday Iran's Guards said two loaded tankers hit mines in Hormuz (unconfirmed), so energy stays bid and inflation risk keeps pressure on long yields. China's Q3 GDP is expected at about 4.4%, below the 4.5-5% target, with BofA and others pointing to more stimulus. Next (AEDT): China GDP and activity data Mon 13:00; Netflix Wed 07:01; Meta, Tesla, Lam, IBM Thu 07:30-08:30; SK hynix Wed Oct 28 11:00; FOMC Thu Oct 29 05:00; Alphabet and Microsoft Thu Oct 29 07:30-08:30; Amazon Fri Oct 30 08:00.
